experiments.hypothesis: The published CURRENT G9 V3 source specimen should parse under the published G9 grammar without semantic reinterpretation.
experiments.compiler_candidate: run-local Lark transcription of published grammar subset
experiments.expected: Published grammar accepts syntax already used by CURRENT G9 V3.
experiments.repair: Add comparison operators >,<,>=,<= and if/else block statement to parser grammar; no Clay semantic record/type change required by this test.
experiments.limitations: Representative exact constructs from CURRENT G9 V3 were tested, not a full-file parser of every grammar production. Full-file conformance remains required before promotion.

experiments.hypothesis: A minimal deterministic checker can enforce the CURRENT G9 rule that textual capability names/model output do not confer authority, while valid possession/delegation/freshness/resource/verb constraints do.
experiments.limitations: Seed checker only. It does not yet implement Witness.aw/cw, nonce/replay, scope predicates, delegation monotonicity proof, or a host capability gateway.
